abort.single_instance_allowed: Pflanzenmonitor Plus is already set up; add plants to it with "Add plant".

user.title: Pflanzenmonitor Plus
user.description: Monitors your plants, learns from the soil moisture history when they were watered and when they need water again, and optionally lets an AI suggest better limits. All fields are optional. Add plants afterwards with "Add plant" (or move them over from Plant Monitor under Repairs).

data_description.ai_task: AI task entity (e.g. Claude). Once a plant is learned, it suggests suitable limits for the species at most once a month (soil moisture, temperature, soil temperature, humidity, illuminance, daily light; only values with a sensor). Nothing changes until you accept. Leave empty to turn suggestions off.
data_description.weather: Hourly forecast for rain and frost warnings of plants outdoors.
data_description.rain_sensor: Measured rain intensity (mm/h). Lets Plus tell rain from watering for plants outdoors; without it (or before it has history), rises outdoors count as unknown and "Last watered" stays empty there.

user.title: Plant
user.description: Name and species. The species helps the AI with its suggestions (e.g. "Dracaena trifasciata").

data_description.species: Botanical or common name. Shown as model on the device page.
data_description.area: Room of the plant. Rooms like terrace, balcony or garden suggest "outdoors" in the next step.
data_description.image: URL or path of a picture, e.g. /local/images/plants/yucca.jpg (optional).

reconfigure.title: Plant
reconfigure.description: Name and species. The species helps the AI with its suggestions (e.g. "Dracaena trifasciata").

data_description.species: Botanical or common name. Shown as model on the device page.
data_description.image: URL or path of a picture, e.g. /local/images/plants/yucca.jpg (optional).

sensors.title: Sensors
sensors.description: The real sensors of this plant. Plus mirrors them on the plant's device page and checks them against the limits. Only soil moisture is needed for learning and watering forecasts; everything else is optional.

data_description.outdoor: Gets rain and frost sensors (with a weather entity in the options); rain does not count as watering.
data_description.illuminance_sensor: Illuminance in lx (converted to PPFD and daily light with the plant's lux to PPFD factor) or a sensor that already measures PPFD (µmol/m²/s).

problems.title: Problems
problems.description: Which readings make the plant show "Problem" when they leave their limits. The status of every reading (too low, too high, OK) is shown either way. Illuminance only counts when it is too bright (it is dark every night), daily light is checked against yesterday.

data_description.moisture_grace: After a watering (soil moisture jumps by 10 points or more), "soil moisture too high" is not reported for this long. 0 = off.

migrate.title: Move plants over from Plant Monitor

confirm.title: Move plants from Plant Monitor
confirm.description:
Moves these plants: {plants}.

Taken over: sensors, the current limits, species, picture, which readings count as problem, the wait after watering, room, labels, names, icons and display settings. Entity IDs stay the same (history continues), only `plant.bogenhanf` becomes `sensor.bogenhanf` (same states ok/problem and attributes). What Plus has learned and the AI history stay.

Afterwards the plants are **removed from Plant Monitor**. Automations, scripts and dashboards that use `plant.…` must then use the new ID `sensor.…`; Plus lists the automations and scripts under Repairs. After that, Plant Monitor can be uninstalled in HACS.
